title: University of Maryland Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The University of Maryland Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) is a student organization at the University of Maryland, College Park. It is listed on TerpLink, UMD’s official club directory, under the name “Taiwanese Student Organization” at the handle umdtsa, and maintains an Instagram account at @umd_tsa and a Facebook group. A founding year and formal mission statement could not be confirmed from available first-party sources.

The TSA appears to operate alongside the longer-established Taiwanese American Student Association (TASA) at UMD, likely serving students from Taiwan as a complement to TASA’s Taiwanese American focus. First-party content from the organization’s own channels was limited at the time of research, so further details about programming and membership are not available for this profile.
